coverage_limits: The eight primary workloads are direct-call and tail-call scalar chains at n=1, 32, 1024, and 10000.
The remaining 77 selected workloads are protected controls; workload and stage counts are derived from the frozen registry.
Deep captured-continuation cases provide correctness and physical-accounting coverage but are not timed by this scalar selection.
The legacy common MIN one-shot warm-batch estimate does not guarantee that both actual timers reached 20 ms.
